definitions: A policy or law under which a person who has been convicted of three felonies or serious crimes is given a mandatory life sentence.
A rule in baseball where a batter is out after three missed attempts to hit the ball.
examples: The new 'three strikes' law aims to deter repeat offenders.
He was out on three strikes, ending the inning.
Critics argue that 'three strikes' policies can lead to overcrowded prisons.
